title: New Extreme Demon Added to Top 5
author: Admin
excerpt: After intense deliberation by the list team, Abyss of Darkness has been placed at #1, pushing all other levels down.
content:
After weeks of evaluation and community feedback, the list team has officially placed **Abyss of Darkness** at position #1 on the Main List.

This decision was not taken lightly. The level has been analyzed by multiple top players who unanimously agreed on its difficulty placement.

## Why #1?

The level features an unprecedented combination of speed, precision, and duration that no other level currently on the list can match. Several of our top players attempted the level and provided detailed feedback.

## What changes with this update?

- Abyss of Darkness enters at **#1**
- Crimson Clutter moves to **#2**
- All subsequent levels shift down by one position

We appreciate the patience of the community during this evaluation period. As always, our goal is to maintain the most accurate and fair list possible.

— *The List Team*
